raw_response:
I have been working this land for 55 years, so I do not need to think too hard. I will do this year like last year, maybe adjust a little.

My 5.2 mu is split the same way every year — wheat in winter, maize in summer. Same ground, two harvests. Everyone in the village does it this way. With just me and my old wife at home, I cannot manage anything more complicated.

**Winter wheat first.** I plant in early October after the maize comes off. I use improved seed — Jimai type, maybe Shiluan. The shop sells it by the bag, I buy about 15 kg per mu because I sow a bit thick, my soil is not the best and some seeds do not come up. Saves worry later.

For base fertilizer I spread compound fertilizer 15-15-15, about one bag (40 kg) per mu before ploughing. That is 6 kg each of N, P, K from the base. Then in spring at green-up I topdress urea — about 30 kg per mu (roughly 14 kg N). So total N is near 20 kg, P around 6, K around 6. That is what the dealer says is right and neighbors do the same. I do not want to cut fertilizer — if wheat is yellow in spring I lose 100 jin, and that hurts more than saving a few yuan.

Irrigation I do 3 times from the well — once before winter to settle the roots, once at jointing in spring, once at grain filling. If rain comes I skip one. Pesticide 2 times — herbicide in spring, then one spray for aphids and rust before heading. Tillage is rotary, my neighbor's small tractor does it for 50 yuan per mu.

Last year I got about 470 kg per mu. I expect similar.

**Summer maize** goes in right after wheat harvest in mid-June. I use hybrid seed — Zhengdan 958 or Denghai, everyone plants these. About 2 kg per mu. No ploughing, I just direct-seed into the stubble — saves time, the ground is too dry to plough anyway in June.

Base fertilizer one bag compound per mu at planting. Then at big trumpet stage I topdress 25 kg urea per mu. Total N about 18 kg, P 6, K 6. Maize needs the topdressing at the right moment or it will not fill the cob.

Irrigation 2 times — one after planting to get it up, one at tasseling if no rain. Pesticide 1 spray for borer and armyworm. Last year maize did around 520 kg per mu. The corn price is not great but the grain is good feed and I can sell what we do not keep.
